notes: MUJI Japan, fetched via curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124 (SSR HTML). '新商品' (New Products) is a top-level desktop-mega-menu AND mobile-accordion-menu nav item (same tier as 特集/読みもの/イベント), resolving to /jp/ja/store/cmdty/section/T00020 - the canonical MUJI category-listing URL shape (/store/cmdty/section/<ID>) used for every ordinary product category on the site, i.e. it is treated by the site's own taxonomy as a normal browsable category, not a marketing page. Verified as a real PLP: SSR pager reads '640件中 1件〜40件表示' (640 total, showing 1-40), with a full filter/sort UI (category filter, price filter, sort-by including 人気順/ranking, カテゴリ順) identical to every other category page, and page 1 has exactly 40 unique product-detail links. Also checked and REJECTED a second candidate found via a homepage hero-carousel banner: /jp/ja/pages/campaign/new-product/latest ('この秋おすすめ 新商品｜新着の商品' - "This autumn's recommended new products") - this is a themed seasonal campaign/editorial landing page (URL under /pages/campaign/, not /store/cmdty/section/); its SSR HTML has zero product-detail links and no pager/count UI, confirming it's editorial marketing content pointing into the same catalogue rather than its own listing, so excluded per brief's 'seasonal campaign pages / marketing landing pages' exclusion. No sub-structure (no 'New Arrivals > Furniture New Arrivals' style children) was found - 新商品 is a single undifferentiated listing across all departments. No other New Arrivals-type nav items (新着/新作/latest) found distinct from T00020.
